messages.subject: PMCMC samples of latent states
parts:
Hi

Pretty sure I'm missing something obvious, but how do I extract the samples for the latent states when using the `RW_PF_block` MCMC sampler?

e.g.
timeModelCode <- nimbleCode({
  x[1] ~ dnorm(mu_0, 1)
  y[1] ~ dnorm(x[1], 1)
  for(i in 2:t){
    x[i] ~ dnorm(x[i-1] + c, pro_error)
    y[i] ~ dnorm(x[i], obs_error)
  }

  pro_error ~ dnorm(0, 1)
  obs_error ~ dnorm(0, 1)
  c ~ dnorm(1,1)
  mu_0 ~ dnorm(0, 1)
})

# simulate some data
seed = 159
t <- 25
mu_0 <- -10
pro_error <- 0.01
obs_error <- 0.5
x <- rnorm(1 ,mu_0, pro_error)
y <- rnorm(1, x, obs_error)
c <- 1;
for(i in 2:t){
  x[i] <- rnorm(1, x[i-1] + c, pro_error)
  y[i] <- rnorm(1, x[i], obs_error)
}

# build the model
rTimeModel <- nimbleModel(timeModelCode, constants = list(t = t),
                          data <- list(y = y), check = FALSE )

cTimeModel <- compileNimble(rTimeModel)

timeConf <- configureMCMC(rTimeModel)

# Add random walk PMCMC sampler with particle number optimization.
timeConf$addSampler(target = c("obs_error", "pro_error", "c", "mu_0"), type = "RW_PF_block",
                    control <- list(propCov= diag(4), adaptScaleOnly = FALSE,
                                    pfType = "auxiliary", pfControl = list(saveAll = T, smoothing = T),
                                    latents = "x", pfOptimizeNparticles = TRUE))
RtimeConf <- buildMCMC(timeConf)
CtimeConf <- compileNimble(RtimeConf, project=rTimeModel, resetFunctions=T)
CtimeConf$run(500)

CtimeConf$mvSamples # This doesn't contain "x"!

Many Thanks

messages.subject: Re: PMCMC samples of latent states
parts:
For recording MCMC samples, you'll need to add a monitor for "x" using the MCMC configuration object:

timeConf$addMonitors("x")

The options you tried, saveAll = TRUE, will control how the nested particle filter algorithm (inside the RW_PF_block MCMC sampler) will operate, but that's located much deeper within the MCMC that you're using.  It sounds like you just want the MCMC algorithm to monitor "x".

messages.subject: Re: PMCMC samples of latent states
parts:
If you're using the PF as part of particle MCMC then NIMBLE will just sample the missing observations as part of the MCMC. So I think that should work fine.

If you're just applying a PF directly, not as part of an MCMC, that won't work as some likelihood terms would be NA. You might instead be able to set up the model
so there are no nodes for the missing observations, and I suspect that would work, but haven't thought carefully about it. Happy to discuss further if this is of interest.

-chris
